title: Monterey Fisherman's Wharf and Presidio Scavenger Hunt
includes: Access to the interactive scavenger hunt and challenges you follow and find with your smartphone.
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Embark on an engaging scavenger hunt through the vibrant streets of Monterey, California. Explore a city renowned for its beauty and history. Delve into the bustling Fisherman's Wharf and let the charm of its unique shops and restaurants draw you in. See the historic presidio and amazing Monterey Bay views. Explore at your own pace feel Monterey's vibrant spirit and take in its quaint charm. Ready to discover Monterey in a whole new way? Let the adventure begin!
